breakdown.description: The prompt switches from the exact thick-walled torsion relation given in the setup to a thin-walled tube approximation, which is a different model.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the core inconsistency. The original prompt incorrectly asked to use both the exact thick-walled torsion relation (by providing the formula for J) and a thin-walled tube approximation. The ground truth resolves this by removing the reference to the thin-walled approximation. The generated specification, however, kept both contradictory instructions by stating to 'Model the shaft as a thin-walled closed tube' while also stating to 'Use the polar moment of inertia J = π(do^4 − di^4)/32'.
